items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: Jake had left, Jake Hanna. And Ronnie Zito came in, took his place. ... So that we could watch Jake Hanna’s hi-hat.

ctx.x: Right. But Bill — “Bijou” was the one that Woody kept having me play. And I really didn’t care for doing that. Listen, Woody Herman was perhaps one of the biggest influences in my life as a musician and as a person. He was special. I didn’t like playing “Bijou” because it was Bill Harris’s piece and I had “Lonesome Old Town.” You know? So I didn’t need to do that, and I didn’t mean to dishonor in a sense Bill Harris. And then came a surprise. There’s an album, a big 10 inch, 12 inch LP “Woody’s Goodies.” When…
